Build an expense and inventory tracking app
A user had Manus create an app to track their business expenses and inventory, and says it works as envisioned.
Done with
MA
Manus
What they did
The source is a short App Store review by a user called Jamaican Nerd. They say they used Manus to create an app for their business to keep track of expenses and inventory. The review gives no detail on the prompts, the steps Manus took, or where the user stepped in.
How it went
The reviewer says the finished app works just as they envisioned and that Manus is now their favorite AI tool. The review gives no numbers, timings, or limitations.
Worth knowing
This is a single short review with no build details, so treat it as an anecdote. Manus is free to download, but the app lists paid in-app plans.
Try it yourself
with
Manus
Copy prompt
Build me a simple web app to track my [type of business] expenses and inventory. It should let me add, edit, and delete expense entries with category, date, and amount, and inventory items with name, quantity, and cost, plus a dashboard showing monthly totals and low-stock items. Finish when the app runs and I can add a sample entry in each section, and ask me before deleting any data.
Original source: https://apps.apple.com/jm/app/manus-ai-agent-automation/id6740909540
